title: Warp Speed for Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) Vaccines: Why Are Children Stuck in Neutral?
ehr_evidence: This is a Viewpoint/commentary article that synthesizes published literature and does not analyze any electronic/computerized individual-level health data.
summary: A narrative viewpoint/opinion piece arguing that pediatric phase 2 COVID-19 vaccine clinical trials should be initiated immediately in the United States given children's infection risk, transmission role, and the health, educational, and economic benefits of vaccination.
data_source_type: other (narrative review of published literature and surveillance data)
limitations: It is an opinion/commentary without primary data analysis or original quantitative results; it relies on cited prior literature and surveillance summaries rather than a defined study dataset.
Authors disclose funding and conflicts of interest related to COVID-19 and other vaccine clinical trials, which may introduce bias.
